notes.title: New Screenshots - Demo Update - Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am developer of Santo Island Incident. Steam Next Fest is very soon, I have listed some news on below for you people. 
Have nice week,

Update of DEMO will be live 13 June, tomorrow.

STORE

-Added new 6 in-game screenshots to store page.

GAME

-New water system.
-New directional sound system with additional sounds.
-Added new 3 mechanics to game.
-Added in-game upgrade station.
-Enhanced lighting on some areas.
-Performance improvements on lights, water, maps.

Follow "Santo Island Incident" Steam page to be up to date with all "Santo Island Incident" news.

[h3][b]Play First Chapter Free:[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1980370/Santo_Island_Incident_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13

Visit Steam page of the game for more information.
